candidate_predicates.name: INTERPRETS_OBSERVATION_AS_NONCOMPLIANT_PROPERTY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning treats a concrete artifact property visible in an observation as evidence that the artifact may violate a formatting, structural, or other acceptance requirement.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that evaluates the observed artifact property.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation displaying the artifact property that is judged noncompliant or risky.

assertion_conditions: The observation displays or reports a concrete artifact property.
The reasoning explicitly connects that observed property to a possible compliance failure and treats it as grounds for corrective action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates or describes the observation without judging compliance.
The observation does not contain the property in question.
The reasoning interprets the observation as confirming compliance or as unrelated to acceptance.

candidate_predicates.name: CHOOSES_PREEMPTIVE_REMEDIATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning decides to modify an artifact proactively to eliminate a possible specification-compliance failure, even though the artifact may already be acceptable under normal handling.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that identifies the risk and selects the proactive correction.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a potential compliance failure and indicates that the artifact may otherwise be acceptable under normal handling.
The reasoning selects a corrective modification to guarantee strict compliance before finalizing.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning responds only to a confirmed failure that must be fixed.
The reasoning identifies a risk but does not decide to modify the artifact.
The reasoning decides to leave the artifact unchanged or only notes the risk.

candidate_predicates.name: IMPLEMENTS_INTENDED_CORRECTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs a modification that the reasoning explicitly intended in order to remove or reduce an identified defect or compliance risk in an artifact or state.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that states the intended corrective change.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The action that carries out the intended modification.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a specific corrective change to be made.
The action performs that change on the same artifact or state.
The action modifies the artifact rather than merely inspecting it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only plans verification, exploration, or a generic next step.
The action reads, lists, or inspects the artifact without changing it.
The action changes a different property or artifact than the one identified in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_CORRECTION_OUTCOME
candidate_predicates.definition: A corrective modification is followed by a targeted inspection whose observation provides evidence that the defect or compliance risk addressed by the modification has been eliminated.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The action that applied the corrective modification.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The later action that inspects the artifact property affected by the correction.

parameters.name: verification_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether the corrected property now holds.

assertion_conditions: The corrective action modifies an artifact to address an identified defect or compliance risk.
A subsequent verification action inspects the relevant property of the same artifact.
The observation reports that the corrected property holds or that the defect is absent.
exclusion_conditions: The verification action inspects an unrelated property or artifact.
The observation does not show removal of the defect or is ambiguous about it.
No corrective modification occurred.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_ARTIFACT_PROPERTY_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted inspection action obtains direct evidence about a specified property of an artifact, and the resulting observation reports whether that property holds.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that specifies the artifact property or requirement to verify.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The targeted inspection action that examines the artifact.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting evidence about the specified property.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies one or more checkable properties or requirements of an artifact to be verified.
The action inspects the artifact's actual representation in a way relevant to those properties.
The observation reports evidence that directly confirms or refutes the specified property.
exclusion_conditions: No explicit artifact property or requirement is being verified.
The action modifies the artifact instead of inspecting it, or inspects unrelated content.
The observation does not report the property or cannot resolve whether it holds.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_EXPECTED_ARTIFACT_PROPERTY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning treats an observation as confirming that an artifact satisfies a property or requirement that was expected or being checked.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that acknowledges or relies on the confirmed property.

parameters.name: observation

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states or implies an expected or required artifact property.

The reasoning acknowledges or relies on the property as holding.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reveals a mismatch or is ambiguous about the property.
The reasoning does not connect the observation to the expected property.
The observation only establishes artifact existence or reports unrelated content.
